assessments.reasoning: The DoSave entry places save processing at completion of the current PeopleCode event. It gives an exhaustive list of eligible calling events covering FieldEdit, FieldChange and ItemSelected, with the last restricted to popup-menu items.

challenge.method: Check whether immediate processing, save-related callbacks, or ItemSelected on an ordinary menu expands the claim.
challenge.results: Immediate processing belongs to DoSaveNow. The save-related callbacks illustrate processing performed during a save. The separate calling-event restriction expressly limits ItemSelected to popup-menu items.

limitations: The claim applies to the documented PeopleTools event API and its stated event contexts.

The event list describes a necessary restriction for supported page processing. DoSave is barred alongside CallAppEngine in the same FieldChange and is unsupported when called through a component interface.
The review verifies vendor documentation for July 2024 PeopleTools 8.60 and did not execute a licensed PeopleTools environment.
This review reopened retained source bytes. Historical reproduction results remain separate.
